moments.title: Strictly 2026 Launch Show Filmed
moments.blurb: The launch show for Strictly Come Dancing's 24th series is being pre-recorded on Wednesday, September 9th, with the new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Launch Hype
angles.copy: The glitterball countdown is ON! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show is being pre-recorded this Wednesday. Who are you buzzing to see on the dancefloor?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 Returns
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing will officially air its launch show on Saturday, September 19th, on BBC One, revealing the celebrity and pro dancer pairings.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! Strictly Come Dancing is back on September 19th. Get ready for the glitz, glamour, and maybe a few dropped lifts!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off 2026 Starts
moments.blurb: Season 16 of The Great British Bake Off premieres on Channel 4 on Tuesday, September 29th, at 8:00 PM, featuring new judge Nigella Lawson alongside Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Baking Excitement
angles.copy: Ready, set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns September 29th. Who's excited to see Nigella Lawson in the tent?

moments.title: Gloria Gaynor turns 83
moments.blurb: Disco icon Gloria Gaynor, known for her empowering anthem 'I Will Survive', celebrates her 83rd birthday on September 7th.

angles.name: Disco Diva
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Gloria Gaynor! Still surviving and thriving, what's your favourite empowering track from her?

moments.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
moments.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday on September 7th.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock trailblazer. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

moments.title: P!nk turns 47
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning pop-rock superstar P!nk, known for hits like 'Get the Party Started' and 'Raise Your Glass', celebrates her 47th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Pop-Rock Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 47th birthday to the one and only P!nk! Still rocking stages and hearts worldwide. What's your go-to P!nk anthem?

moments.title: Dave Stewart turns 74
moments.blurb: Musician, songwriter, and producer Dave Stewart, best known as one half of the iconic duo Eurythmics, celebrates his 74th birthday on September 9th.

angles.name: Synth-Pop Mastermind
angles.copy: Sweet dreams are made of... 74 years! Happy birthday to Eurythmics' Dave Stewart, the genius behind so many classic tracks.

moments.title: Michael Bublé turns 51
moments.blurb: The smooth Canadian crooner Michael Bublé, known for his jazz and pop hits, celebrates his 51st birthday on September 9th.

angles.name: Smooth Operator
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 51st birthday to the king of cool, Michael Bublé! What's your favourite song to get lost in his voice?

moments.title: Joe Perry (Aerosmith) turns 76
moments.blurb: Legendary Aerosmith lead guitarist Joe Perry, co-writer of many of their biggest hits, celebrates his 76th birthday on September 10th.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to Aerosmith's iconic axeman, Joe Perry! Forever a rock legend. What's your favourite Aerosmith riff?

moments.title: Siobhan Fahey turns 68
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter Siobhan Fahey, known for her work with Bananarama and Shakespears Sister, celebrates her 68th birthday on September 10th.

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: Cruel Summer? Not today! Happy 68th birthday to the fabulous Siobhan Fahey from Bananarama and Shakespears Sister!

moments.title: Moby turns 61
moments.blurb: Electronic music pioneer and DJ Moby, known for influential albums like 'Play', celebrates his 61st birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Dance Music Innovator
angles.copy: A very happy 61st birthday to the legendary Moby! What's your favourite track from the electronic music maestro?

moments.title: Richard Ashcroft (The Verve) turns 55
moments.blurb: The charismatic frontman of The Verve, Richard Ashcroft, known for anthems like 'Bitter Sweet Symphony', celebrates his 55th birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Britpop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the 'Mad Richard' himself, Richard Ashcroft! What's your ultimate Verve track?

moments.title: Peter Cetera (Chicago) turns 82
moments.blurb: Former lead singer and bassist of the band Chicago, Peter Cetera, known for hits like 'Hard to Say I'm Sorry', celebrates his 82nd birthday on September 13th.

angles.name: Soft Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the distinctive voice of Peter Cetera! From Chicago to solo success, what's your favourite song he sang?

moments.title: Niall Horan turns 33
moments.blurb: Irish singer-songwriter Niall Horan, globally recognised as a member of One Direction and for his successful solo career, celebrates his 33rd birthday on September 13th.

angles.name: Pop Heartthrob
angles.copy: Happy 33rd birthday to the brilliant Niall Horan! What's your favourite track from his incredible career, solo or 1D?

moments.title: Morten Harket (a-ha) turns 67
moments.blurb: Norwegian singer Morten Harket, best known as the lead vocalist of the synth-pop band a-ha, celebrates his 67th birthday on September 14th.

angles.name: Synth-Pop Icon
angles.copy: Take on him! Happy 67th birthday to Morten Harket of a-ha, whose voice defined the 80s. What's your favourite a-ha hit?

moments.title: Nas turns 53
moments.blurb: Influential American rapper and record executive Nas, considered one of the greatest MCs of all time, celebrates his 53rd birthday on September 14th.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Legend
angles.copy: Illmatic talent! A massive happy 53rd birthday to the legendary rapper Nas. What's your top track from the Hip-Hop icon?

moments.title: Autumn has arrived
moments.blurb: Autumn officially began on September 1st in the Northern Hemisphere, bringing cooler weather and changing leaves across the UK.

angles.name: Autumn Vibes
angles.copy: Cosy jumpers, pumpkin spice, and crunchy leaves! Autumn is officially here. What's your favourite thing about the season?
